$comment: Wave V1 of the component variants plan (docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md): actions and inputs. kinds lists each kind's variants (id, name, what it is for, the pattern it follows, its source and licence, and its motion: enter, hover, press, change and reduced motion). components lists every catalogue component of those kinds (the text effects are wave V5) with its variants, its base motion (motion.json) and the packs it is built in. The variant property adds the class bx-<kind>--<variant> to the component's host (JET, Angular) or a display: contents wrapper (React); React Native maps it to styles in variants.tsx. An empty variant keeps the pack's own look. In React the material variant of a foundation component renders @mui/material; tools/gen-variants.js writes each pack's table from this file.
